#### Setup
Library imports
```{python}
#Import packages
import pandas as pd

#Utils
import src.utils.runtime as util
import src.utils.network as net
import src.utils.comorbidities as cc
```

Load runtime settings
```{python}
settings = util.load_settings()
```

#### Load Base SUS Data

Import the data
```{python}
#Connect to DB
engine = net.db_connect(settings["sql_dsn"], settings["sql_database"])

#SUS Spell data
df_sus_spell = net.load_data(settings, "sus_spell_script", "sql", engine)

#Convert date into month and year
df_sus_spell["date_full"] = pd.to_datetime(
    df_sus_spell["admission_date"]).dt.date
df_sus_spell["date_year"] = pd.DatetimeIndex(
    df_sus_spell["date_full"]).year
df_sus_spell["date_month"] = pd.DatetimeIndex(
    df_sus_spell["date_full"]).month
```

#### Patient Level Datasets

Cormorbidity Data
```{python}
#Load the data
##SUS Comorbid ICD Codes
df_episode_icd = net.load_data(settings, "sus_episode_icd_script", "sql", engine)
##CC Score Data
df_cc_list = net.load_data(settings, "cc_list_file", "csv")

#Create copies of the base data frames
df_tmp = df_sus_spell.copy()[["pid", "hrg_code"]]
df_episode_icd_working = df_episode_icd.copy()
df_cc_list_tmp = df_cc_list.copy()

##Clean the cc_list data
df_cc_list_tmp = df_cc_list.copy()

#Remove suffix of the list ID
df_cc_list_tmp["hrg_group"] = df_cc_list_tmp["List ID"].apply(
    lambda x: x.split("_")[0])

#Split longer items into multiple rows
def split_hrg_group(code):
    return [code[i:i+2] for i in range(0, len(code), 2)]

df_cc_list_tmp["hrg_group"] = df_cc_list_tmp["hrg_group"].apply(split_hrg_group)
df_cc_list_tmp = df_cc_list_tmp.explode("hrg_group", ignore_index=True)


#Merge with the SUS data to get HRG information for the spell
df_episode_icd_working = df_episode_icd_working.merge(
    df_tmp, how="left", left_on="PRIMARYKEY_ID", right_on="pid")

#Convert to HRG Code to HRG Group (First few non-numeric characters)
#Note, my understanding from the CC List data is some HRG Groups are longer than 2 characters but I couldn't find an example in the data
df_episode_icd_working["hrg_code"] = df_episode_icd_working["hrg_code"].fillna("")
df_episode_icd_working["hrg_group"] = (
    df_episode_icd_working["hrg_code"].apply(lambda x: x[:2]))
df_episode_icd_working["join_key"] = (
    df_episode_icd_working[["hrg_group", "code"]].agg("_".join, axis=1)
)

#Create a join key using the hrg_group and code
df_cc_list_tmp["join_key"] = (
    df_cc_list_tmp[["hrg_group", "Code"]].agg("_".join, axis=1)
)
df_cc_list_tmp = df_cc_list_tmp[["join_key", "Value"]]

#Join the episode code data to the cc list data to get value per episode code
df_episode_icd_working = df_episode_icd_working.merge(
    df_cc_list_tmp, how="left", left_on="join_key", right_on="join_key")

df_episode_icd_working["Value"] = df_episode_icd_working['Value'].fillna(0)
df_episode_icd_working["pid"] = df_episode_icd_working["PRIMARYKEY_ID"]

#Derive count of comorbidities and total CC Score
df_episode_icd_agg = df_episode_icd_working.groupby(["pid"]).agg(
    count_comorbidities = ("pid", "size"),
    cc_score = ("Value", "sum")
).reset_index()
```

HRG Trim Data

```{python}
#Load HRG Trim data
df_hrg_trim = net.load_data(settings, "hrg_trim_file", "csv")

#Clean HRG data
df_hrg_trim_clean = df_hrg_trim[["HRG Code", "HRG Name", 
    settings["hrg_trim_days_column_el"], 
    settings["hrg_trim_days_column_nel"]]].copy()
df_hrg_trim_clean.columns = ["hrg_code", "hrg_name", 
    "hrg_trim_days_el", "hrg_trim_days_nel"]

#Derrive the lower and upper bounds
df_hrg_trim_clean["cc_range"] = df_hrg_trim_clean["hrg_name"].apply(
    cc.get_score_from_name)
df_hrg_trim_clean["ccr_lower"] = df_hrg_trim_clean.loc[:, "cc_range"].apply(
    cc.get_lower_and_upper)
df_hrg_trim_clean["ccr_upper"] = df_hrg_trim_clean.loc[:, "cc_range"].apply(
    cc.get_lower_and_upper, args=[1])

#Remove unused columns
df_hrg_trim_clean = df_hrg_trim_clean[["hrg_code", "hrg_trim_days_el", 
    "hrg_trim_days_nel", "ccr_lower", "ccr_upper"]]

df_hrg_trim_clean.loc[:,"hrg_code"] = df_hrg_trim_clean["hrg_code"].astype(str)
```

#### Merge Into Patient Level Dataframe 
```{python}
df_working = df_sus_spell.copy()

#Set type of hrg_code column as it was interfering with the join
df_working["hrg_code"] = df_working["hrg_code"].astype(str)

#Integrate the HRG Trim data
df_working = df_working.merge(
    df_hrg_trim_clean, how="left", left_on="hrg_code", right_on="hrg_code")

##Filter out data with no HRG Trim data. 
##See commit cadf52e22e50b64b7074446f05ded53fd8ef3013 for details.
df_working = df_working[~df_working["hrg_trim_days_el"].isnull()]

#Merge CC data with working data frame
df_working = df_working.merge(
    df_episode_icd_agg, how="left", left_on="pid", right_on="pid")
```

#### Create Base Dataframes for Provider and Site Level Data
```{python}
#Create a copy of the patient level df
df_hierarchy_base = df_working.copy()

#Strip uneeded columns
df_hierarchy_base = df_hierarchy_base[["provider_code", "site_code", 
    "date_year", "date_month", "date_full"]]

#Create the site level table
df_site_base = df_hierarchy_base.drop_duplicates(keep="first", inplace=False)
df_site_base.reset_index(inplace=True, drop=True)

#Create the trust level table
df_trust_base = df_hierarchy_base[["provider_code", 
    "date_year", "date_month", "date_full"]]
df_trust_base = df_trust_base.drop_duplicates(keep="first", inplace=False)
df_trust_base.reset_index(inplace=True, drop=True)
```

#### Provider Level Datasets

Hospital Acquired Infections
```{python}
df_hospital_infections = net.load_data(settings, "hospital_infections_script", "sql", engine)
```

Workforce Sickness
```{python}
df_workforce_sickness = net.load_data(settings, "workforce_sickness_script", "sql", engine)
```

Workforce Vacancy
```{python}
df_workforce_vacancy = net.load_data(settings, "workforce_vacancy_script", "sql", engine)
```

Join trust level data to base df
```{python}
df_trust_working = df_trust_base.copy()

df_trust_working = pd.merge(
    df_trust_working, df_hospital_infections, how="left", 
    on=["provider_code", "date_year", "date_month"])

#Add dynamic join column for the sickness data
df_trust_working["sick_join"] = df_trust_working.apply(
    lambda row: 
    "RAL" if row["provider_code"] == "RAP"
    else row["provider_code"], 
    axis=1)

df_trust_working = pd.merge(
    df_trust_working, df_workforce_sickness, how="left", 
    on=["sick_join", "date_year", "date_month"])

df_trust_working = pd.merge(
    df_trust_working, df_workforce_vacancy, how="left", 
    on=["provider_code", "date_year", "date_month"])
```

#### Site Level Datasets

Bed Occupancy
```{python}
df_beds = net.load_data(settings, "beds_script", "sql", engine)
df_beds["date_full"] = pd.to_datetime(
    df_beds["date_full"]).dt.date
```

Medically Optimised
```{python}
df_mo = net.load_data(settings, "medically_optimised_script", "sql", engine)
df_mo["date_full"] = pd.to_datetime(
    df_mo["date_full"]).dt.date
```

Join site level data to base df
```{python}
df_site_working = df_site_base.copy()

df_site_working = pd.merge(
    df_site_working, df_beds, 
    how="left", on=["provider_code", "site_code", "date_full"])

#Add dynamic join column for the mo data
df_site_working["mo_join"] = df_site_working.apply(
    lambda row: 
    row["provider_code"] if row["site_code"] not in ["RAL01", "RAL26", "RALC7"] 
    else row["site_code"],
    axis=1)

df_site_working = pd.merge(
    df_site_working, df_mo, 
    how="left", on=["mo_join", "date_full"])
```

#### Collate hierarchy into single dataset

Combine the trust level df into the site level df
```{python}
df_site_collated = pd.merge(df_site_working, df_trust_working,
    how="left", on=["provider_code", "date_year", "date_month", "date_full"])
```

Combine the site level df into the patient level df
```{python}
df_collated = pd.merge(df_working, df_site_collated,
    how="left", on=["provider_code", "site_code", "date_year", "date_month", "date_full"])
```
